name: Dome / closed-roof over

luck.marketProbabilityKind: per-leg market products for parlays, de-vigged single price otherwise
luck.null: per-bet Bernoulli with p = de-vigged market probability of the side taken
luck.interpretation: pValueVsMarket = probability that a bettor with NO information beyond the closing market would earn at least this ROI. Small values are the only defensible evidence of skill.

G1_provenance.detail: every input dataset is in nfl-lines/data/sources.json

G3_baseline.detail: market reference is the de-vigged closing price, not a naive guess

G4_leakage.detail: walk-forward: all inputs dated before kickoff

G7_prospective_trial.detail: requires a frozen version and predictions logged before outcomes; no trial has been run, so this gate is always open

description: Bet the over in every game played under a dome or closed roof at the quoted price.
features: Roof field from the archive (dome/closed vs outdoors/open).
gateNote: Population bet; no interactive filter, so the multiple-testing risk is limited to the family size.

description: Build each club's points-scored and points-allowed rate with a 6-game prior toward the league mean, combine the two clubs into a fair total, and bet only when the fair total differs from the closing number by at least 1.5 points.
features: Only graded results enter the rate table; the accumulator is updated after each bet is priced.
gateNote: The fair total is compared with the closing line, not the opening line, so no line-move edge is claimed. Pushes are dropped.

description: Fit the Elo probability gap to an expected home margin with an expanding least-squares regression on already-graded games, compare that fair number with the closing line, and bet when the two differ by at least 1 point.
features: Same Elo as s1 plus a two-parameter margin mapping refitted point-in-time. No injury, rest or weather input.
gateNote: Pushes are dropped. The mapping has to be refitted with at least 300 graded games before the strategy can place a bet, which is why the early seasons contribute no bets.

description: Bet the side whose Elo win probability exceeds the de-vigged closing moneyline probability by at least 2 percentage points.
features: Elo from results only, margin-weighted, season regression, 48-point HFA, updated after grading.
gateNote: Walk-forward Elo; no injury, no rest, no weather inputs. Market comparison is closing, so the strategy is evaluated against the sharpest public reference in the archive.

description: Same rule as s7 with three legs. Included to expose how parlays concentrate variance.
features: Three legs multiply both the payout and the estimation error.
gateNote: Included deliberately: a three-leg parlay is far more likely to look lucky than skilful, which is exactly what the luck gates below quantify.

description: Every week, take the two largest Elo moneyline edges and combine them into one two-leg cross-game parlay at the product of the two quoted moneylines.
features: Legs come from different games, so game-script correlation is limited but shared-week information and the product-price assumption are both measured in the correlation section.
gateNote: Parlay payout is the product of the leg decimals; that is an upper bound on what a book usually pays and is labelled as such. Empirically measured joint dependence is published.
